system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: At 13:44 UTC, nora.blake created the domain account ext.rwong; the account was added to the Freelancers group shortly afterward.
Before the account creation, DC-NWD-01 recorded a network logon by nora.blake from WS-NBLAKE-01. Its logon ID matches the subject logon ID used for the account-creation and group-addition events.

The account name and Freelancers group addition are consistent with the stated help-desk practice for temporary accounts, but the records do not establish whether this particular account was approved or requested.

Cisco AnyConnect's VPN UI was launched under nora.blake's session after the account creation, and a Cisco-signed, valid vpnapi.dll was loaded. The inventory says the organization has no VPN; these events establish the client launch, not a VPN connection.

known_telemetry_limitations: Proxy collection was unavailable from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC, overlapping the account creation and VPN UI launch; the supplied proxy event at 13:27 UTC is outside that gap. (T048-00002)
Although Zeek sensors are reported as operational, no Zeek connection, DNS, or TLS event records for this review window were provided.
claims_not_established: Whether ext.rwong was requested or authorized through the organization's temporary-account process.
Whether the new account received group memberships or privileges beyond the Freelancers addition shown.
Whether Cisco AnyConnect attempted or established a VPN connection, or why it was launched.
Whether ext.rwong was subsequently used to authenticate or access resources.
Whether any relevant network activity occurred during the proxy collection outage.
additional_evidence_needed: The help-desk ticket or other approval record for ext.rwong, plus the account's full group and privilege state after creation.
VPN client and VPN gateway logs, if any, and endpoint network telemetry for WS-NBLAKE-01 around 13:40–14:10 UTC.
Proxy logs for the outage interval and the corresponding Zeek connection, DNS, and TLS records.
